A1.justification: Both complete 18-page PDFs describe the same LLMEval-3 study. The text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–F support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original model evaluations, contamination replay tests, error analyses, ranking stability experiments, and human–judge agreement results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Question construction, dynamic sampling, JWT/RBAC safeguards, GPT-4o judging, relative scoring, and the authentication algorithm remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both use the same university-exam question bank, academic domains, AGIEval English/Chinese and C-Eval comparisons, and prompting and web-search scenarios.

E2.justification: The evaluated models, judge alternatives, static benchmarks, and Elo comparator are unchanged. GPT-4o search appears newly in Figure 2 but was already evaluated in v1’s Tables 1 and 7.

E3.justification: The stated sampling sizes, prompting procedures, scoring definitions, reference model, and contamination-testing protocol are unchanged. Figure 2’s numerical revisions are not accompanied by a documented protocol change.

E4.justification: The prompting, thinking/search, contamination replay, error-analysis, resampling, judge-validation, and relative-versus-Elo analyses are retained without substantive additions or removals.

E5.justification: Independent-run counts, two human-evaluation rounds, variance reporting, correlation p-values, and Cohen’s kappa reporting remain unchanged, including the appendix tables.

E6.justification: Figure 2 substantially revises the historical score series: GPT4 Turbo moves from approximately 100 to 73.6, and GPT-3.5-turbo from approximately 70.5 to 51.9. The fitted longitudinal trajectory also changes. Tables 1–10 retain their numerical values; these plotted revisions do not establish experimental reruns.

T1.justification: The absolute-score and relative-score definitions in Equations (1)–(2) are unchanged. Neither version adds theoretical propositions, proofs, or formal assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the dynamic-evaluation contribution, longitudinal-study scope, performance-ceiling claim, contamination claims, and ranking-reliability claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning knowledge gaps, comprehension failures, prompting effects, contamination, and ranking stability remain unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: The appendix prompts, question schema, authentication pseudocode, expert staffing, annotation duration, costs, and repository access information are retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to static benchmarks, human-preference evaluation, and LLM-as-a-judge research remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 removes five authors and the ByteDance affiliation/contact information. It corrects references from Section 4 to Section 3 and from Section 4.3 to Section 3.4; the scientific prose and section organization are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is redrawn and moved from page 5 to page 4, with larger, repositioned labels, revised axis ticks and grouping ellipses, and an additional search-model point. Other displays remain substantially unchanged, with local formatting and text reflow.

improvement.justification: Figure 2’s revised historical scores now align with the existing absolute-score leaderboard, including GPT4 Turbo’s 73.6 in Table 7, improving internal consistency. Clearer labels and corrected section references also help. These gains are localized; the underlying study and scientific arguments remain unchanged.
